apps.name: Photon
apps.notes: First release: layers & groups, selections (Magic Wand, Quick Selection, lassos), Free Transform, 27 blend modes, adjustment layers, filters, layer styles, PSD open/save and Export Layer As.

apps.name: Prism
apps.notes: First release: a clean Chromium browser with built-in ad & tracker blocking (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock Origin lists), HTTPS upgrades, third-party cookie blocking, private windows, tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads and no telemetry.

apps.name: Cut
apps.notes: Fixes the video preview freezing during playback while the audio kept going. The preview now sits on top with the timeline below, the project frame is outlined so its aspect ratio is easy to see, and the preview footer shows the project format (click it to change). New: Match media in Project Properties and Match Project Video Settings in the media bin.
